killers.name: R-DURABLE a staged row sends nothing: its outputs leave once it is committed

R-DURABLE a crash before flush loses the belief, not the outputs: they all leave again
R-DURABLE a crash between apply and commit loses the staged frame and nothing durable
R-DURABLE every world nothing can move in is the finished one, and a finished world is reached
R-DURABLE planted bug: a flush that lets a staged frame's outputs leave is caught
R-DURABLE planted bug: a flush that never marks its rows sent repeats them without end
R-DURABLE planted bug: a recovery that forgets the last row is caught
R-DURABLE R-X1 every run settles; nothing halts or leaves ahead of its disk, with junk hashes and ids
R-DURABLE planted bug: a shell that sends a row's outputs when it asks for the write, not after
R-DURABLE the sender never believes the peer holds more than the peer made durable
R-DURABLE planted bug: an ack that leaves with the write request gives Alice a head Bob lacks
R-DURABLE a frame that has begun asks for its row to be made durable, sends nothing and holds the Host
R-DURABLE the outputs of a row leave only once the row is durable, once, and never an earlier row's
R-DURABLE after a crash the Host is the durable rows alone, and every committed output leaves again
